g.text: Direct output at the target sampling
each convolution receives the input and all earlier features
Dense-block kernels: 3 × 3. LeakyReLU after convolutions 1–4. Concatenate → final convolution → residual addition.
Shuffle = PixelShuffle. Both models: signed linear normalization; masked L1 loss; no output clipping.
Residual super-resolution: shared features, two routes to 5× sampling
